slots.prompt:
A photorealistic television news anchor speaks directly to camera in a modern broadcast studio. The anchor and studio remain exactly as the reference start frame: same man, bald head, trimmed styled beard, dark navy suit, white shirt, dark tie, seated at the curved desk on the left of the frame, same lighting, same navy-blue-and-cyan newsroom, same rear displays. The glass hologram panel on the right of the frame stays in place. Hologram screen timeline, clip length 11.5 seconds, speech starts at 0 seconds. 0.0 to 0.5 seconds: the AI News Desk logo on the blue holographic screen, exactly as in the reference start frame. 0.5 to 3.0 seconds: the logo fades out slowly; the screen stays empty, plain blue glass with its thin glowing blue border, no picture, no text. 3.0 to 7.0 seconds: a glowing earth appears in the centre of the screen, and the electric logo line runs around the globe in one steady circle; no letters, no numbers, no flags. 7.0 to 7.5 seconds: the earth fades out and the original logo fades back in at the exact same size, position and brightness as the start frame. 7.5 to 11.5 seconds: the original logo holds, unchanged, until the end of the clip. The screen content stays inside the glowing border and never rises above the top rail; the desk reflection follows the screen; nothing else in the studio changes. At same time The anchor says exactly, in natural English, at a natural, unhurried pace, in an authoritative and informative news presenter tone, clear and easy to understand, never rushed, positive: "Welcome to A I News Desk. I am Raphael, and Every day, I bring you the headlines from all fields of A I. The tech, The money, The people, and the tools shaping our world. 90 seconds. starting now!" at the last second of the speech, when  it is the end of the sentence he puts his hands on the table and go back to the same position he started <reference image 01>.
He holds steady professional news energy. He stays the same person in one continuous stable broadcast. In the final second he settles and rests his hands together on the desk.
Static camera, locked framing, no camera movement. Natural subtle head and hand movement only. Accurate lip synchronization to the spoken words. Natural eyes, natural skin.
Audio: the anchor's voice only, with quiet professional studio ambience. No music.
Exclusions: no captions, no subtitles, no lower thirds, no ticker, no on-screen text, no date, no logo redesign, no second person, no camera shake, no zoom, no cuts, no scene change, no morphing, no plastic skin, no hollow eyes.

slots.script: First, the money. Elon Musk's rocket and A I company SpaceX reportedly wants forty billion dollars in loans for chips, showing how much money A I needs.

slots.symbol: a small glowing data centre building beside a simple raised open hand in a stop gesture, text-free symbol
slots.script: In energy. Towns that said no have reportedly sunk two hundred and sixty billion dollars of U S data centre plans, so A I needs the neighbours' yes.

slots.symbol: a small glowing car seen from the front with an empty driver's seat and a simple steering wheel, text-free symbol
slots.script: Driverless cars next. Robotaxi firm Waymo is now driving in Detroit with no one at the wheel, though so far only its staff can ride.

slots.symbol: a small glowing robotic hand holding a simple sewing needle with a thread, text-free symbol
slots.script: Staying with robots. Chinese start-up Agilink says its robot hand can thread a needle and stitch silk embroidery, the fine touch home robots will need.

slots.symbol: a small glowing document page with a simple sparkle beside its edge, text-free symbol
slots.script: In software. A I firm an-thropic has put a test version of its Claude assistant in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides so paying users get help in their files.

slots.symbol: a small glowing medicine bottle beside a simple shield with a check mark, text-free symbol
slots.script: Turning to safety. Nobel-winning A I pioneer Geoffrey Hinton wants A I firms to prove their models safe before release, as drug makers must.
slots.source: Business Insider, as republished by AOL.com

slots.symbol: a small glowing group of seven simple figure outlines with three of them faded, text-free and number-free symbol
slots.script: Now to jobs. U S pollster Pew finds seven in ten Americans expect A I to mean fewer jobs, and worry grew most among the young.
slots.source: Radio Ink, citing Pew Research Center

slots.symbol: a small glowing prison window with bars and a simple speech bubble floating out of it, text-free symbol
slots.script: And now a smile. The jailed mayor of Albania's capital sent voters an A I double of himself promising free school meals from his prison cell.

slots.symbol: a small glowing closed report folder with a simple bookmark ribbon, text-free symbol
slots.script: Also in the full report. French firm Mistral claims its new A I model beats some Chinese rivals, and Nigeria's election body says A I will help check its vote.

slots.symbol: a glowing warning triangle sign that flashes the words "This is not financial advice" inside the blue border
slots.script: And for the bigger picture: SpaceX reportedly plans to borrow for A I chips, so watch next week's U S inflation figure since high inflation makes loans cost more.
Those were today's headlines in ninety seconds. For more detailed coverage, read our daily news cards. Thank you for tuning in, and we'll see you tomorrow.
